integrity: The closed forms are derived analytically from reflected-root logarithmic Fourier series. Their signs are certified by exact rational interval arithmetic in the bundled checker; floating-point values are descriptive only.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the classical three-term pair and its two even-endpoint derivatives; it does not extend the closed forms to general frequency gaps. An inaccessible earlier version of a 2026 all-gap paper is retained as an originality risk because its version history mentions a removed endpoint section.
title: Exact endpoint slopes for the classical three-term Hardy--Littlewood majorant defect
